You are purchasing a "Limited Edition Walnut Briar Wood Pen and Pencil Set" in "Used" condition.
Elegant walnut briar wood pen and pencil set, perfect for anyone who loves classic, refined writing tools. This Limited Edition briar wood pen and pencil set features warm walnut barrels paired with rich gold-tone accents, giving it a timeless, upscale look that stands out on any desk. You’ll receive one ballpoint pen and one mechanical pencil in the original presentation box, along with the outer "Limited Edition Briar Wood Pen and Pencil Set" sleeve. The walnut finish and slim profile make these pieces comfortable to hold and stylish to use, whether for daily notes, signatures, or as a special gift. If you appreciate traditional craftsmanship and the look of real wood, this handsome matching set will make a great addition to your office, study, or collection. Keywords: walnut pen, wood pen set, briar wood pen pencil, limited edition pen pencil, vintage style pen set, gold tone pen, mechanical pencil set, desk writing set, walnut writing instruments

Pen and mechanical pencil appear clean with smooth walnut wood barrels and shiny gold-tone metal accents. No major scratches or chips are visible on the writing instruments. Outer cardboard box shows noticeable wear including scuffs, discoloration, and creasing, with some fraying on edges and opening flaps. Inner presentation box has light surface wear but remains intact.
